description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for single action strategies within a connectivity messaging persistence context. It provides a framework for handling connectivity commands and producing corresponding connectivity events, with a focus on executing a single connection action.

classes.name: AbstractSingleActionStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class for strategies that execute a single connection action in response to connectivity commands. It defines an abstract method to specify the action and implements a method to process the command accordingly.

methods.name: AbstractSingleActionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that registers the class type for command matching.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Abstract method to return the specific connection action to be undertaken.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy by creating a staged command with the specified connection action and returns the resulting event and command.
